EXPERIMENT 10 – Intrusion Detection System (Snort)
This experiment uses Snort commands and a custom rule, not a Python program.
10(a). Custom Snort Rule
Add this to local.rules:

alert icmp any any -> any any (msg:"LAB ICMP Ping Detected"; sid:1000001; rev:1;)



10(b). Test configuration
sudo snort -T -c /etc/snort/snort.conf


10(c). Start Snort
sudo snort -A console -q -c /etc/snort/snort.conf -i eth0


10(d). Generate ping traffic
Run from another terminal on your authorized lab network:
ping -c 4 192.168.1.20


Expected alert:
[**] [1:1000001:1] LAB ICMP Ping Detected [**]

{ICMP} 192.168.1.10 -> 192.168.1.20



Important: Libraries to install before the exam
Run these commands if the corresponding packages are not installed:
pip install pycryptodome numpy
